questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number. 

5 : 27 :: 7 : ? :: 8 : 39
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: (First number × 4) + 7 = Second Number**

1) 5 : 27

⇒ 5 × 4 + 7 = 20 + 7 =** 27**

And,

2) 8 : 39

⇒ 8 × 4 + 7 = 32 + 7 = **39**

Similarly,

3) 7 : ?

⇒ 7 × 4 + 7 = 28 + 7 **= 35**

Hence, the correct answer is **"35".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

119 + 11 × 5 – 153 ÷ 17 = 201
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/1GCDVOWNBvTYyOVoC65TWS6H9eXCmSfFv43DaVimInnSL6_AX5JJ_LMMstUoEomvXAD2-bD6iEvdpHfubOqPNhpszHj65xIZE_DVupuIGiMrDqy-i173FmUE10S9sPknA_qwHadrFc-L0DlnQcAroQ] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 17 and 5. So the equation will become:

⇒ 119 + 11 × 17 - __**153 ÷ 5**__ = 201

⇒ 119 + **__11 × 17 __**- 30.6 = 201

⇒ __**119 + 187**__ - 30.6 = 201

⇒ 306 - 30.6 = 201

⇒ 275.4 ≠ 201

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 2) 119 and 17. So the equation will become:

⇒ 17 + 11 × 5 - __**153 ÷ 119**__ = 201

⇒ 17 + __**11 × 5 **__- 1.2857 = 201

⇒ __**17 + 55 **__- 1.2857 = 201 

⇒ __**72 - 1.2857 **__= 201

⇒ 70.7143 ≠ 201

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 3) 119 and 153. So the equation will become:

⇒ 153 + 11 x 5 - __**119 ÷ 17**__ = 201

⇒ 153 + __**11 x 5**__ - 7 = 201

⇒ __**153 + 55**__ - 7 = 201

⇒ __**208 - 7**__ = 201

⇒ **201 = 201**

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 4) 11 and 17. So the equation will become:

⇒ 119 + 17 × 5 - __**153 ÷ 11**__ = 201

⇒ 119 + **__17 × 5 __**- 13.90 = 201

⇒ __**119 + 85 **__- 13.90 = 201

⇒ 204 - 13.90 = 201

⇒ 190.1 ≠ 201

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"119 and 153".**

questions.question: An amount of ₹1,003 is to be distributed among A, B and C in the ratio of 11 : 23 : 25. How many rupees would B get more than A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the share of A, B and C respectively = 11 : 23 : 25

**Calculation:**

Let the share of A, B and C be 11x, 23x and 25x respectively.

According to the question

⇒ 11x + 23x + 25x = 1003

⇒ 59x = 1003

⇒ x = 17

Now B get more than A = B -A = 23 - 11 = 12

⇒ Now, 17 × 12 = 204

Hence, the correct answer is **"204".**

'P$Q' means 'P is to the north of Q'.

'P&Q' means 'P is to the east of Q'.

'P*Q' means 'Q is to the west of P'.

'P%Q' means 'Q is to the south of P'.

'P@QR' means 'P stands exactly in the middle of horizontal line QR'.

'P!QR' means 'P stands exactly in the middle of vertical line QR'.

Note: 'P6m$Q' means 'P is 6 m to the north of Q' and so on.

Find the shortest distance between G and C in the following expression. 

C12m$S5m*G3m&J6m%K!JT

 **Code**

Given: C12m$S5m*G3m&J6m%K!JT 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e62f75ff58d6ee07734189df65531dd5f6d67333de8b899b21fd10f1faec7099.png] 

According to the Pythagoras theorem,

(Hypotenuse)² = Base² + Height²

⇒ CS is Height = (12)²

⇒ GS is the Base = (5)²

⇒ GC is the Hypotenuse = ?

Therefore,

⇒ (GC)² = (GS)² + (CS)² 

⇒ (GC)2 = (5)² + (12)²

⇒ (GC)2 = 25 + 144

⇒ (GC)² = 169

⇒ GC = **√**169

⇒ GC = 13

Hence, the correct answer is **"13 m".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All calculators are markers.

Some markers are pencils.

Some pencils are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are markers.

II. Some pencils are calculators.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf3d676a47fba4d150a312d8baa4c00a62eeab63c2c0cf1461ea2761f700a42.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are markers → Does not follow → (As all calculators are marker, some pencil are marker and some eraser are pencil. So, some eraser are markers is possibility but not definite true)

II. Some pencils are calculators → Does not follow → (As all calculators are marker and some pencil are marker. So, some pencils are calculators is possibility but not definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**

questions.question:
'Z + Y' means 'Y is the son of Z'.

'Z $ Y' means 'Y is the father of Z'.

'Y % Z' means 'Y is the son-in-law of Z'.

'Z – Y' means 'Y is the wife of Z'.

'Y * Z' means 'Z is the brother of Y'.

'Y # Z' means 'Z is the only sister of Y'

Which two symbols can sequentially replace the question marks (?) in the following expression to show that ‘D is the wife of W’?

W % O – B ? C ? D
questions.solution:
Let us first decode the given data:

 
 

 **Code**
 +
 $
 %
 -
 *
 #
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Father
 Son-in-law
 wife
 brother
 sister
 
 

Family Chart:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

Given: W % O – B ? C ? D

**Option 1) % and – **

After interchanging we get: W % O – B % C - D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is the wife of O.

3) B % C means B is son-in-law of C. **(Here B is not a son-in-law of C because B is a female)**

4) C - D means D is wife of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47b98af6229fae0bda0500a0ba3785b7aa7e15454150f3f742921127cd3ad864.png] 

It is false because, here B is the female and given relation is wrong.

**Option 2) $ and +**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B $ C + D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B $ C means C is father of B.

4) C + D means D is son of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e2bc6c36f89318ed964157168256032154beddbc9c0129f36b8d8a9a6bab02.png] 

It is false because, here D is the uncle of W.

**Option 3) + and #**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B + C # D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B + C means C is son of B.

4) C # D means D is only sister of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97a598929d6f28a1fb809c58ddf9d2522d33a809e419822ef1bc408af906496c.png] 

**It is true, here D is the wife of W.**

**Option 4) + and -**

After interchanging we get: W % O – B + C - D

1) W % O means W is the son-in-law of O.

2) O - B means B is wife of O.

3) B + C means C is son of B.

4) C - D means D is wife of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47b98af6229fae0bda0500a0ba3785b7aa7e15454150f3f742921127cd3ad864.png] 

It is false because here, D is the sister-in-law of W. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and #".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** D has to be the wife of W which means she needs to be female and going by all symbols we can see that only the - and # symbols represent female but the "-" symbol means wife and that is not possible because this would mean D is the wife of C so the only symbol left is # and the answer is 3rd.
